name: Engineering contract LINE conversation archives
scope: Draft, issued, signed, and internal-preview PDF composition

dataIsolation.guard: Only messages related to the contract's authoritative Engineering group binding are queried; archives remain in the dedicated contract database and private Engineering Drive root.

changes: Add immutable tenant-scoped LINE conversation archive evidence
Capture each interval before draft review and final formal issue
Render sender, time, content, media, message IDs, and hashes into a private PDF
Append all prior archives to merged draft, issued, and signed PDFs
Expose protected archive files and a historical backfill action in Engineering AM
definitionOfDone: V1 captures all stored group messages up to its send boundary
Each later version starts strictly after the prior archive boundary
Archive failure prevents LINE send or formal issue
Archive retries are idempotent and evidence cannot be updated or deleted
Existing V1/V2 intervals can be reconstructed without resending LINE
Authorized staff can open each archive separately and in the merged contract PDF
